info.name: CareConnect EHR API
info.description: Run "POST /api/auth/login" first - it stores the tokens in collection variables. Change the username in its body to test other roles (demo password: Password@123).

request.description: Log in and receive an access token (15 min) and a refresh token (7 days) (roles: Public)
Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair (the old refresh token is revoked) (roles: Public)
Revoke the given refresh token (roles: Any signed-in user)
Current user profile (roles: Any signed-in user)
Change own password (signs out other sessions) (roles: Any signed-in user)
Stat cards, charts and work list for the logged-in user's role (roles: Any signed-in user)
List departments (roles: Any signed-in user)
Add a department (roles: Admin)
Update a department (roles: Admin)
List users (admin) (roles: Admin)
User details (roles: Admin)
Create a user account (admin) (roles: Admin)
Update a user (roles: Admin)
Activate or deactivate a user (deactivation ends their sessions) (roles: Admin)
Reset a user password (roles: Admin)
Doctors directory (for appointments and messaging) (roles: Any signed-in user)
Patient's documents (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Upload a lab report, scan or other document (PDF/PNG/JPEG/WEBP/TXT, max 10 MB) (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Receptionist)
Download a document (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Delete a document (roles: Doctor, Admin)
Search patients by name, MRN, date of birth or phone (paged, sortable) (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist, Receptionist, Admin)
Register a new patient (an MRN is generated) (roles: Receptionist, Doctor)
Patient demographics (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist, Receptionist)
Update demographics (send the last seen 'version' to detect concurrent edits) (roles: Receptionist, Doctor)
Soft-delete a patient record (admin) (roles: Admin)
Allergies (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Add an allergy (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Update an allergy (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Problem list (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Add a problem (roles: Doctor)
Update a problem (roles: Doctor)
Immunizations (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Add an immunization (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Update an immunization (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Family history (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Add family history (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Update family history (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Search ICD-10 codes by code prefix or description (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist, Admin)
Add an ICD-10 code (roles: Admin)
Update an ICD-10 code (roles: Admin)
SOAP note templates (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist, Admin)
Open an encounter (visit) for a patient (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Worklist: my encounters (doctor) or all encounters (nurse) with the given status (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Encounter with notes, diagnoses and vitals (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Patient's encounters (paged) (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Close an encounter (all notes must be signed) (roles: Doctor)
Add an ICD-10 diagnosis (PRIMARY replaces the current primary) (roles: Doctor)
Remove a diagnosis from an open encounter (roles: Doctor)
Patient's clinical notes (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Start a DRAFT SOAP note on an open encounter (roles: Doctor)

request.description: Edit a DRAFT note (author only) (roles: Doctor)
Sign a note - it becomes read-only (roles: Doctor)
Add a signed addendum to a signed note (roles: Doctor)
Record vital signs (BMI is calculated automatically) (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Vital sign history, oldest first (for trend charts) (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Run decision support without saving (allergy, interaction, duplicate checks) (roles: Doctor)
Create an order. Returns 409 CDS_ALERTS (with alerts in 'details') when an override reason is needed (roles: Doctor)
Place a DRAFT order (runs decision support) (roles: Doctor)
Order worklist with filters (paged) (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Order with alerts, result and prescription (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Move a lab/imaging/referral order forward (e.g. PLACED -> IN_PROGRESS when the sample is collected) (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Cancel an order (reason required) (roles: Doctor)
Enter a lab value or imaging report; the value is flagged against normal/critical ranges (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Patient's orders (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Encounter's orders (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Patient's lab and imaging results (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Lab test catalogue (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist, Admin)
Add a lab test (roles: Admin)
Update a lab test (roles: Admin)
Chart header: demographics, active allergies, problems, medicines, latest vitals, open encounters (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Active, verified medicines that can be administered to the patient (roles: Doctor, Nurse)
Medication administration history (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Document a dose given / held / refused / missed (roles: Nurse)
Prescription queue, e.g. status=PENDING_VERIFICATION for the pharmacist (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Prescription with its decision-support alerts and the patient's allergies (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Medication list of a patient (activeOnly=true for current medicines) (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist)
Pharmacist verifies a prescription (roles: Pharmacist)
Pharmacist rejects a prescription (reason required) (roles: Pharmacist)
Dispense a verified prescription (reduces stock) (roles: Pharmacist)
Doctor stops a medicine (reason required) (roles: Doctor)
Change dose/frequency: discontinues this prescription and places a new medication order (roles: Doctor)
Search the drug formulary (paged) (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist, Admin)
Drug details and stock (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist, Admin)
Drugs at or below their reorder level (roles: Pharmacist, Admin)
Add a drug (roles: Pharmacist, Admin)
Update a drug (roles: Pharmacist, Admin)
Receive stock or adjust it (writes an inventory ledger entry) (roles: Pharmacist, Admin)
Last 50 stock movements (roles: Pharmacist, Admin)
Drug-drug interaction table (roles: Doctor, Nurse, Pharmacist, Admin)
Add an interaction (roles: Pharmacist, Admin)
Delete an interaction (roles: Admin)
A doctor's slots on a date (availableOnly=true for booking) (roles: Receptionist, Doctor, Nurse, Admin)
Generate availability slots for a doctor over a date range (roles: Receptionist, Doctor, Nurse, Admin)

Unblock a slot (roles: Receptionist, Doctor, Nurse, Admin)
Search appointments (provider, patient, status, date range) (roles: Receptionist, Doctor, Nurse, Admin)
Patient's appointments (roles: Receptionist, Doctor, Nurse, Admin)
Book an appointment into a free slot (roles: Receptionist, Doctor, Nurse, Admin)
Cancel an appointment (reason required) (roles: Receptionist, Doctor, Nurse, Admin)
Check in, complete or mark no-show (roles: Receptionist, Doctor, Nurse, Admin)
My conversations (one per doctor or patient), newest first (roles: Doctor, Patient)
Messages exchanged with one user (marks them read) (roles: Doctor, Patient)
Send a message (patient <-> doctor) (roles: Doctor, Patient)
Unread message count (roles: Doctor, Patient)
My notifications (paged) (roles: Any signed-in user)
Unread notification count (roles: Any signed-in user)
Mark one notification read (roles: Any signed-in user)
Mark all notifications read (roles: Any signed-in user)
My demographics (roles: Patient)
